meta.name: Kaalkoot
meta.description: Follows the life of Ravishankar Tripathi, a tenacious and dedicated police officer who finds himself at the forefront of a challenging acid attack case.

videos.title: Janam Din
videos.overview: Ravi Tripathi becomes frustrated after joining the police force and contemplates resigning from his post. However, his perspective changes when he receives a case of an acid attack. Will he stick to his decision?

videos.title: M for Mafia
videos.overview: Ravi starts his investigation to uncover the truth about Parul's acid attack. Later, he is taken aback when he learns a disturbing fact about her character. What will Ravi do now?

videos.title: Rocky
videos.overview: Ravi's grandmother calls him and asks him to visit her. At the police station, Ravi is ordered to contact Mridul and faces taunts from his colleagues. How will Ravi spend the rest of his day?

videos.title: Nail Polish
videos.overview: Ravi and his mother visit Shivani and her father to discuss the matter of their prospective marriage. Later, Ravi and Yadav visit the hospital to meet Parul, a victim of an acid attack. Who is the culprit?

videos.title: Dus Nabbey
videos.overview: Yadav flatters Jagdish as the latter grumbles about his wife's annoying habits. Later, Jagdish seeks Ravi's help to investigate Parul's case. Will Ravi be able to find any leads about the perpetrator?

videos.title: Ardhsatya
videos.overview: Ravi's mother informs him that Shivani is preparing dinner. However, Ravi is shocked when he sees Shivani having an epileptic seizure. How will Ravi react to Shivani's secret medical condition?

videos.title: Al Makhtoob
videos.overview: Ravi is upset with Shivani for keeping a secret about her epileptic seizures and is unwilling to forgive her despite her apologies. Ravi and Yadav begin to investigate Zakir Siddiqui. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Pathar
videos.overview: Ravi instructs Yadav to investigate Parul and Ashish's activities at the cyber cafe. However, Yadav informs Ravi that no records are available about the suspects. Will Ravi find any leads?
